caption: The drawing depicts a single ceramic jug with a rounded body and a narrow, cylindrical neck. The jug features a short, wide spout that extends diagonally upward from the left side, marked with a series of dark blue circular spots along its length. There is a single handle attached vertically near the neck and shoulder of the jug. The vessel is primarily tan and brown in color with darker areas suggesting surface wear or shadow. Ornamental blue designs decorate the jug, including stylized floral or leaf motifs and clusters of dots, as well as cursive script reading “Blue” and “New.” The background is plain and lightly colored, leaving the focus entirely on the jug. The artist’s signature, “Yolanda Delasser,” is in the lower right corner.
title: Water Jug
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
